wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(out)
exp=wb['Result what i am expecting ']
if 'MyResult' in wb.sheetnames:
    del wb['MyResult']
ws=wb.create_sheet('MyResult')
for r in range(1,21):
    for c in range(1,16):
        v=exp.cell(row=r,column=c).value
        ws.cell(row=r,column=c).value=v
wb.save(out)
print('done')
